prompt: As of the financial year ending July 31st 2023, what was the size of the endowment at the university attended by rugby player Fred McLeod?
answer: Fred McLeod attended the **University of Edinburgh**. For the financial year ending **31 July 2023**, the university’s endowment fund was valued at approximately **£559.8 million**.
